promptText:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI desktop app redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 04-B-01-home-dashboard/default as a calm TOPIK study dashboard.
Direction: study priority cockpit.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 screenshot with fixed left sidebar. Make the next best learning action visually dominant: large AI tutor recommendation, smaller progress and alert modules around it, dense but breathable dashboard rhythm. Preserve KPI row, continue-writing area, unreviewed feedback, recent feedback, quick start, scheduled exam, and notifications.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly compact operational workspace.
Color palette: neutral Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian palette, dark #09090b primary action only, subtle dividers, monochrome icons.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: workspace panels should use restrained 4-8px radii; one clear primary action per task area; color signals must be paired with text or icons; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: loud AI gradients, colorful AI styling, chromatic repeated CTAs, oversized soft bubbles, heavy card shadows, decorative orbs, watermark, raw implementation/debug text.
negativeConstraints: no distorted Korean text as final copy
